title: House holds hearing on UFO transparency and whistleblower protection | full video
description:
A House committee held a hearing on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena, commonly known as UAPs or UFOs, and the need for more transparency and whistleblower protection. Among the witnesses testifying were U.S. Air Force veterans Jeffrey Nuccetelli and Dylan Borland, journalist George Knapp, and U.S. Navy senior chief petty officer Alexandro Wiggins, who says he saw a UAP event.
